g.text: a) 请确保不要将皮带轮完全插入，
皮带轮表面与电机轴顶部之间留出 3 毫米的距离。
b) 您可以使用 U 形夹具来确定皮带轮在轴上的位置，
方法是将夹具放置在皮带轮下方的电机本体上。"
a) Make sure not to insert the pully all the way down
and leave a distance of 3mm between
the face of the pully and the top of the motor shaft
b) You can Use U-shaped jig to define puley location on shaft
by placing it on the motor body under the pully
